aiAssist.badge.description: Pill on every admin AI card: what it shows is a draft

aiAssist.working.defaultMessage: Drafting. This takes a few seconds.
aiAssist.working.description: While the model writes the draft

aiAssist.failed.defaultMessage: The assistant could not draft this. Carry on by hand or ask again.
aiAssist.failed.description: The draft failed (model error or a number it could not back up)

aiAssist.check.defaultMessage: Check each line, then use, edit or skip it. Nothing changes until you confirm.

aiAssist.partly.defaultMessage: Some lines were applied. The ones you may not apply are still here.
aiAssist.partly.description: After a confirm that left refused lines open

aiAssist.applied.defaultMessage: Done. What you chose was applied and recorded in the audit log.

aiAssist.choice.label.description: Accessible name of a line's use / edit / skip switch; line is the line's heading

aiAssist.choice.use.description: Option: use the drafted line as it is

aiAssist.choice.edit.description: Option: edit the drafted line before using it

aiAssist.choice.skip.description: Option: do not use this line

aiAssist.notPermitted.defaultMessage: Your role cannot apply this line. Ask someone who can.
aiAssist.notPermitted.description: A line the signed-in admin's role may not apply

aiAssist.lineInvalid.defaultMessage: Check this line: a value is missing or not allowed.
aiAssist.lineInvalid.description: A line the confirm refused, or an edit that is empty or too long

aiAssist.nothing.defaultMessage: Nothing left to decide in this draft.
aiAssist.nothing.description: Every line of the draft is settled

aiAssist.confirm.description: Button: send the use / edit / skip choices

aiAssist.error.cap.defaultMessage: AI help is paused until tomorrow.
aiAssist.error.cap.description: 429 ai_daily_cap_reached: the platform's daily AI limit

aiAssist.error.off.defaultMessage: The assistant is not available here right now.
aiAssist.error.off.description: 404: the feature is off or the draft is gone

aiAssist.error.moved.defaultMessage: This item changed since the draft. Reload and ask again.
aiAssist.error.moved.description: 409: the product left the queue or the ticket moved on

aiAssist.error.invalid.defaultMessage: Check the lines you chose and try again.

aiAssist.error.forbidden.defaultMessage: Your role cannot use this assistant.

aiAssist.error.network.defaultMessage: Could not reach TodayZ. Check the connection and try again.

aiAssist.catalogue.intro.defaultMessage: Draft clean fields, a likely duplicate and missing category names for this product.
aiAssist.catalogue.intro.description: A-08 assistant: before it is asked

aiAssist.catalogue.normalise.description: Line heading: the product's normalised fields

aiAssist.catalogue.useFields.description: Option: apply the normalised fields to the pending product

aiAssist.catalogue.duplicate.description: Line heading: the active product this one duplicates

aiAssist.catalogue.useMerge.description: Option: merge the pending product into the drafted one

aiAssist.catalogue.into.description: Field: the active product to merge into

aiAssist.catalogue.mergeInto.description: The drafted duplicate; similarity is a percentage

aiAssist.catalogue.names.description: Line heading: the category's names in five languages

aiAssist.catalogue.useNames.description: Option: save the drafted category names

aiAssist.catalogue.mergeOrEdit.defaultMessage: Merge or clean up, not both: skip one of the two lines.
aiAssist.catalogue.mergeOrEdit.description: Both the clean fields and the merge are chosen

aiAssist.triage.intro.defaultMessage: Draft a category, priority and order guess, a summary of a long thread, and a reply.
aiAssist.triage.intro.description: A-14 assistant: before it is asked

aiAssist.triage.classify.description: Line heading: drafted category, priority and order

aiAssist.triage.useClassify.description: Option: set the ticket's category and priority

aiAssist.triage.order.description: Field: the order the ticket is about

aiAssist.triage.summary.description: Line heading: summary of a long thread, for the agent only

aiAssist.triage.useSummary.description: Option: mark the summary as used

aiAssist.triage.reply.description: Line heading: drafted reply to the opener

aiAssist.triage.useReply.description: Option: send the drafted reply to the opener

aiAssist.risk.intro.defaultMessage: Draft a short summary of what this rule counted, using only the flag's own numbers.
aiAssist.risk.intro.description: A-13 assistant: before it is asked

aiAssist.risk.summary.description: Line heading and field: the drafted summary

aiAssist.risk.useSummary.description: Option: record the summary on the flag's audit trail

aiAssist.risk.editHelp.defaultMessage: Use only numbers shown in the evidence.

aiAssist.risk.ungrounded.defaultMessage: A number in this summary is not in the evidence. Use only the flag's own numbers.
aiAssist.risk.ungrounded.description: 422 ungrounded: an edited summary added a number
